consultantNotes: Nevada is primarily a LAND-BASED market for slots. Online authorisation is poker-only, so an online slot product cannot enter Nevada as such.
The 75% floor is the same as the GLI-11 / GLI-19 default, which makes Nevada one of the least demanding RTP jurisdictions. Commercial competitiveness, not compliance, will set the real RTP target.
Because Regulation 14 changed effective 2026-02-26 specifically including ITL submission content, any submission package prepared before that date should be re-checked.
